bootstrap.algorithm: NumPy default_rng multinomial session multiplicities; means weighted by retained frame counts

paired_scope_contract.common_operational: Both output poses available, including fallback.
paired_scope_contract.candidate_new_pose: Candidate produced a new pose; comparator output available. Historical fixed comparator is reused, not falsely counted as a new estimate.
paired_scope_contract.both_new_pose: Both arms produced new poses. Empty against historical BASE/N3_SUBPIX by design.
paired_scope_contract.population_caveat: Hypotheses were motivated by prior DEV319 diagnostics; this is post-hoc development, not new held-out validation.

mask_known_relation.reason: No mask applied; label mismatch is not a classifier error.

uncertainty: Sample variance/SD describe error dispersion; bootstrap CI describes paired mean uncertainty over repeated 13-session draws. Neither is seed variability or independent physical validation.
corner_contract: Distances use the frozen same-coordinate initial baseline phase; DIRECT_VISIBLE and SELF_OCCLUDED separated. Hidden references may be derived. Unknown inputs remain unknown. Report mean frame and mean corner separately. No success gate is applied from classification or hidden-corner error.
